title: Phage Administration Protects Against-Induced Mastitis Through Direct Pathogen Lysis and Subsequent Alleviation of Host Inflammatory Responses in a Murine Model.
snippet: ()-induced mastitis poses a severe threat to the global dairy industry and raw milk safety. This study aimed to evaluate the protective effects of lytic phage JXAU-SA-P1, recently isolated in our laboratory, against-induced mastitis in mice and to elucidate its underlying mechanisms.
